title: 進路セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
teachers:
HIROMITSU Nagayoshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
In order to clarify the purpose of continuing studies or finding a job, self-development is required in this course.
Students will:
(1) learn self-analysis and how to perform a job search
(2) learn job types and vocational aptitudes
advice:
We will cover the following items:
(1) Methods of job searches
(2) Factory tours
(3) Self promotion
(4) Corporate interviews
(5) Practice exams
requiredKnowledge:
Career Seminar II is a lecture designed to prepare students for the actual job-hunting process.
No particular prior knowledge is required, but all students, regardless of whether they plan to continue their studies or find employment, should take this course in order to gain numerous contact points with actual companies, shape their career paths, and learn about the mindset required for job hunting, the preparations they need to make, and key points to keep in mind.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the activity process from course selection to decision.
Be able to act by collecting and analyzing information.
Be able to recognize required aptitudes and achievements.
Be able to clarify the ideas that form the core of your career path and explain them to others.
